messages:
Anya: Noticing a p99 blip on the UI for /v1/chat yesterday at 03:12 UTC. p50/p95 flat, p99 went from 220ms -> 640ms for ~8m. Could be routing or ingress queuing.
Liam: Do we have the breakdown by stage? Console only shows total + model_infer today.
Anya: I pulled span samples: ingress_queue and routing had the largest tails. Model_infer unchanged.
Cheng: If spans are sampled independently then computing p99 per-stage will be noisy. We either need consistent per-request sampling or emit a compact per-request telemetry blob.
Liam: Sketch: agent emits a map on request completion: {ingress_ms, routing_ms, decode_ms, infer_ms, total_ms, sample_origin, rollout_id} and we compute quantiles on each field server-side.
Anya: That would avoid cross-shard tdigest merge problems for p99. Current tdigest rollup means extreme values can be under/over-estimated if stage events get sharded.
Cheng: Alternative is to keep spans but ensure they carry request_id and shard-keying so the rollup collocates same-request spans before quantile aggregation. More infra work.
Liam: For the UI: add a toggle "Per-stage percentiles" in the latency pane. When enabled, show a table with rows [ingress, routing, decode, infer, total] and columns p50/p95/p99. Also show a small badge if sample_coverage < 80% or if sample_origin != telemetry_origin.
Anya: UX note: when a rollout is active, annotate the time-series with rollout weights + region split. Seeing p99 correlated with a 40% weight shift to EU is very helpful.
Cheng: Edge cases: retries and speculative prefetchs. If agent emits per-attempt durations we need to decide whether stage fields represent sum across attempts or just first attempt. I vote per-request summed durations.
Liam: SQL-ish prototype for console backfill endpoint:
```sql
-- assume per_request_map table with request_id, endpoint, ts, meta_map
SELECT
  quantileExact(0.5, meta_map['ingress_ms']) AS p50_ingress,
  quantileExact(0.95, meta_map['ingress_ms']) AS p95_ingress,
  quantileExact(0.99, meta_map['ingress_ms']) AS p99_ingress,
  -- repeat for routing_ms, decode_ms, infer_ms
FROM per_request_map
WHERE endpoint = '/v1/chat' AND ts BETWEEN ts_start AND ts_end
```
Note: quantileExact is heavy; if we stick with tdigest we must emit consistent sketches per-request.
Anya: Operational ask: add a short-term dashboard annotation when any rollout weight changes >10% within 15m of a p99 change. Even a dumb overlay helps triage.
Cheng: I'll write a short RFC proposing the per-request map fields + fallback behavior when maps are absent. It will include data retention and cardinality bounds (limit extra fields to the 5 numbers + tags).
Liam: I'll prototype a lightweight internal API that the console can call: /internal/telemetry/stage-quantiles?endpoint=/v1/chat&period=15m which returns the table. If coverage is <90% it returns coverage=true/false as a header.
Anya: ops-bot: file an action for SRE to run a quick host-level tail-check on EU proxies for the 03:12-03:20 window.
ops-bot: created task TASK-8821 assigned to eng-sre.
Cheng: Timeline: RFC by Tue, prototype API by end of next week, console toggle + rollout overlay after API validation.
Liam: Sounds good. In the meantime we should mark the dashboard with a temporary note about sample provenance to avoid mis-attribution.
Anya: Thanks team. If you see similar p99 jumps, drop the rollout weight timeline and the per-route sampling badge here. :ok_hand:
